metadata.title: Hardening in a Time--Evolving Stellar Background: Hyper--Velocity Stars, Orbital Decay and Prediction for Lisa

notes: No eligible individual stars are identified. The paper discusses a simulated, unnamed population of “hypervelocity stars” and “returning” stars generically (e.g. T:p1-b3, T:p3-b1, T:p3-b4, T:p7-b3), without providing any star names or catalogue identifiers. Its unbound/ejection statements concern stars in the MBHB scattering model, not an identified Galactic unbound star.
